data: ﻿Bébé Tigre, c’est Many, 17 ans. Il vit en France depuis deux ans et mène la vie d’un adolescent comme les autres, partageant son temps entre les cours, ses copains et sa petite amie. Mais les responsabilités que ses parents restés en Inde lui ont confiées vont l’obliger à se mettre en danger. (Bébé Tigre is Many, a 17-year-old Indian boy who has been living in France for two years. A teenager like any other, he divides his time between school, friends, and his girlfriend. But the pressures placed on him by his parents in India force him to put his own life at risk...)

﻿Bébé Tigre, c’est Many, 17 ans. Il vit en France depuis deux ans et mène la vie d’un adolescent comme les autres, partageant son temps entre les cours, ses copains et sa petite amie. Mais les responsabilités que ses parents restés en Inde lui ont confiées vont l’obliger à se mettre en danger.

Bébé Tigre is Many, a 17-year-old Indian boy who has been living in France for two years. A teenager like any other, he divides his time between school, friends, and his girlfriend. But the pressures placed on him by his parents in India force him to put his own life at risk...
